title: .Net Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para .Net Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular)

Salary: $5,500 – $6,500 USD per month (based on experience)

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (EST)

Location: Fully remote (Latin America)

Latino Legends is conducting a search on behalf of one of our innovative, fast-growing clients in the marketing and digital delivery space.

Our client is a technology-driven marketing organization that builds and scales high-performance digital platforms for global brands. They specialize in developing advanced marketing systems, product delivery solutions, and integrated digital experiences that support microsites, social media, and complex backend operations. The company is known for embracing modern technologies, agile practices, and continuous innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Full Stack Developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to play a key role across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key contributor to the client's technology team. You will go beyond implementation—helping architect, design, and scale applications that power a global digital ecosystem. From backend services to modern frontend interfaces, your work will directly impact performance, scalability, and user experience.

Technical Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core/MVC, and Entity Framework. Experience designing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Frontend Expertise: Advanced experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Angular (v12+), including state management, component architecture, and performance optimization.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, plus cloud platforms such as Azure (preferred) or AWS/GCP. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Software Craftsmanship: Solid understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, unit testing/TDD, and Agile/SCRUM methodologies.
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Comfortable mentoring teammates, participating in code reviews, and contributing to best practices within distributed teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and develop scalable, high-quality applications using modern .NET and Angular frameworks.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Maintain high standards for code quality through documentation, testing, and peer reviews.
  • Research and implement new technologies to keep the platform modern and competitive.

Why Join This Opportunity?

  • Modern, cloud-native technology stack with minimal legacy constraints.
  • Collaborative, professional work environment with high technical standards.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
  • Strong work-life balance with PTO and recognized holidays.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Recruiter em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we're the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.

Role Overview

We're looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America, partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates' time zone

Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We're building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accountingand legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Technical Product Owner
description:

ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua.Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!Principais atividades:Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional.Buscamos alguém que apresente:Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR)Conhecimento específicos:Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurançaAntes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Informações da vaga:Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

- Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiarvalidações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático dePython para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial comDatabricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICATitle:Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations Company:Fulcrum SaaS Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:Full-time Level:Senior / Staff Compensation:USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and locationAbout Fulcrum SaaS Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable. Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.The Role We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers. You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars. You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.What You'll Do Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements. Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery. Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation. Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise. Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure. Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation. Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.What We're Looking For (Must-Haves) 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better). Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes. Deep working knowledge of Go's concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity. Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred;
Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable. Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures. Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like. Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure. Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable. Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate. Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).Strong Nice-to-Haves Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic). A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks. Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches. Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.What We Offer Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM. Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices. Direct access to leadership;
your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented. A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.How to Apply Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting: Your experience with Go in production. The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned. Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA

Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company: Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type: Full-time

Level: Senior / Staff

Compensation: USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location

About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.

The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.

What You'll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.

What We're Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go's concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred;
    Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).

Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.

What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership;
    your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.

How to Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client's financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models

Minimum Education:

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

metrics, and traces to diagnose problems independently -Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Grafana or equivalent) to track service health, detect anomalies, and support proactive incident management -Write simple automation scripts (Python) for bulk operations — e.G., mass API retries, data migrations, batch status checks -Leverage AI tools (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) with integrated system access to accelerate troubleshooting — including prompt engineering, using AI skills/contexts, and working with MCP (Model Context Protocol) -Collect and structure full technical context (logs, alerts, code changes) for bug reports when escalation to development is required -Monitor service status proactively: identify and initiate resolution of incidents before customers report them -Collaborate with development, DevOps, and product teams via Slack and Jira for escalations and knowledge sharing -Contribute to the internal Knowledge Base to improve AI-assisted resolution and team efficiencyRequirements:Required: experience working with the LATAM market.AI & Automation ● Practical experience using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor or similar) as daily work tools — not just casual use, but integrated into troubleshooting and communication workflows ● Understanding of prompt engineering principles and ability to craft effective prompts for technical tasks ● Familiarity with AI integration concepts: MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI skills/contexts, connecting AI to internal systems (preferred, can be trained)Observability & Monitoring ● Hands-on experience with Grafana and/or Datadog — specifically building dashboards, creating alerts, and working with data sources (not just consuming alerts from Slack) ● Understanding of the observability stack: logs, metrics, traces, and how they connect ● Experience navigating traces to identify performance bottlenecks or failure points in distributed systems Scripting & Technical Automation ● Ability to write simple Python scripts for practical tasks: iterating over API endpoints, bulk retries, data extraction, automated reporting ● Comfortable reading and understanding code (Python, Go, JavaScript) even if not writing production-level software ● Experience working with REST and RPC APIs: understanding HTTP methods, status codes, request/response structureComputer Science Fundamentals ● Solid understanding of how computers work: CPU, RAM (volatility, cache hierarchy L1/L2/L3), storage (SSD/HDD), and why these matter for debugging ● Understanding of network protocols: HTTP/HTTPS, gRPC, WebSocket — and when each is used ● Understanding of microservices architecture vs. monolith: distributed system challenges (retries, exponential backoff, rate limiting, eventual consistency) ● Basic understanding of DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN (Cloudflare), VPNSupport & Communication ● 2+ years of experience in technical support or TechOps roles (FinTech experience preferred) ● Background in Forex or Crypto — either through trading or working with a broker ● English proficiency at C1 level — both written and spoken ● Experience working with CRM platforms ● Ability to determine when a problem needs escalation and to provide complete technical context when doing soYou can send your CV and portfolio here or to @anutik_sysoeva

ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technology Manager (Licensed Entities) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.

You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions)

Nice to Have

  • AWS experience

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk Management Officer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
    postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
    fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário. Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais. Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog. Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders. Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia. Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão. Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.Requisitos desejáveis Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico, agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais. Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais. Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde. Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.Competências esperadas Forte senso de dono sobre o produto Excelente capacidade de priorização Visão de negócio com foco no usuário Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável Escuta ativa e boa facilitação Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto Alto nível de autonomia e accountabilityO que esperamos de sucesso nessa posiçãoO roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde. - Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Java Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AVMetrixé uma plataforma SaaS que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.Propósito do Cargo ComoSenior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento Backend Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.Banco de Dados e Integrações Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.Requisitos Obrigatórios: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.O Que Valorizamos: Qualidade acima de velocidade:preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA:você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design:você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico:considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. Ownership:leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real. Curiosidade:se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício. Comunicação clara:escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura:Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico:Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão:Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.Por que trabalhar na VMetrix NaVMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, aVMetrixé o lugar.

title: Business Analyst
description:

The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO's absence or when additional facilitation is required. Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad's delivery capabilities. Required Experience & Skills Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria. Hands‐on experience with JIRA and Confluence. Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban). Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‐management skills. Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner. Detail‐oriented, proactive, and delivery‐focused mindset. Nice to Have Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner. Experience supporting cross‐functional or distributed Agile teams.

description:

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Driven Platforms)

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong experience designing, building, and scaling modern web applications and SaaS platforms. In this role, you will work across the entire stack, from intuitive frontend interfaces to robust backend services, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered solutions. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver high-impact, scalable systems.

  • Design, develop, and scale full-stack web applications and SaaS platforms
  • Build high-quality, maintainable frontend experiences using modern frameworks
  • Develop APIs and backend services with a focus on performance, security, and scalability
  • Architect and manage cloud-native infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
  • Implement AI-powered features using foundation models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures
  • Ensure reliability through automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and observability best practices
  • Collaborate in English on a daily basis with cross-functional and international teams

Technical Requirements

Frontend

  • Strong experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.Js
  • Proficiency with modern CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS

Backend

  • Solid experience with Node.Js (Express and/or NestJS) and/or Python (FastAPI or Django)

Databases

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or AWS Aurora
  • Experience with Vector Data Stores (Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, or Pinecone)

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Deep familiarity with AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, API Gateway) or GCP
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK)

AI & Orchestration

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock (working with foundation models like Claude or Llama)
  • Experience with Google Vertex AI
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and RAG architectures

DevOps & CI/CD

  • Experience with Docker and GitLab CI
  • Strong knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, AWS CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, and Google Cloud Logging

Testing

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, PyTest, Playwright, or Cypress

Developer Tools

  • Advanced proficiency with AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitLab Duo, and Claude Code

Language Requirements

  • Advanced English proficiency for daily communication

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. title: Subject Matter Expert - Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role;
instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a\ "bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.

What you'll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional\ "human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.

What you'll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.G., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.

Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.

  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)

    collaborate with SDETs on integration testing

  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
